facts: The historic hall by Peter Behrens and Karl Bernhard stands along Berlichingenstraße, with its monumental gable on Huttenstraße. The hall was extended north beginning in 1939.
The 1908–09 hall has prominent concrete corners, steel frames and huge glazed surfaces. Its 1939–40 extension retains a simpler structural language.

record: TU Wien building history, original hall section
facts: The original two-aisle building is reported as about 123 m long, 39 m across and 28 m high. The currently mapped outline includes the later northward extension.
